name: Ace in the Hole

description.content: Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:

items: A Visceral or lower rarity add-on.
[100%] chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.

description.content: When you escape, you keep your add-ons.

quote: "Everything that glitters isn't gold. But gold isn't worth a damn in this place, so this should come in handy." -Ace
